fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the usage of the "Squirrel.exe" to download arbitrary files. This binary is part of multiple Electron based software installations (Slack, Teams, Discord, etc.)
fields.name: Arbitrary File Download Via Squirrel.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\squirrel.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\update.exe") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " --download " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " --update " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " --updateRollback=") and tgt.process.cmdline contains "http"))
